name: should report a download that returns {"ok":false,"notReady":true} as 'notReady'
fullName: SellerOrderDetailScreen waybill should report a download that returns {"ok":false,"notReady":true} as 'notReady'
description:
Seller's sold orders (v3): the Selling-tab card (status-bearing id, what the
seller earns, Download waybill) and the order detail — Screen 4 (order, product,
link to shipping) and its shipment page (waybill + tracking controls, and the
outcome of a waybill download). The Maestro flows in
.maestro/flows/orders/seller-*.yaml drive these on the real QA seller; these
tests cover the states that account may not be in.
